## שָבֵעַ (id: BDB09346)

[Dt 31:20](https://ref.ly/Deut31:20); 3 pl. שָבֵָעוּ [Is 9:19](https://ref.ly/Isa9:19), ´וש: consec. [Dt 14:29](https://ref.ly/Deut14:29), [26:12](https://ref.ly/Deut26:12), etc.; *Impf.* 3 ms יִשְבַּע [Pr 12:11](https://ref.ly/Prov12:11) \+, 3 mpl. יִשְבְּעוּן [Psalm 104:28](https://ref.ly/Ps104:28), etc.; *Imv.* שְבַ־ע [Pr 20:13](https://ref.ly/Prov20:13); *Inf. abs.* שָבוֺע [Jo 2:26](https://ref.ly/Joel2:26), [2 Ch 31:10](https://ref.ly/2Chr31:10); cstr. לִשְבֹּע [Ex 16:8](https://ref.ly/Exod16:8), [La 5:6](https://ref.ly/Lam5:6), לְשָבְעָה [Hg 1:6](https://ref.ly/Hag1:6);—**1\.** *be sated* (with food), esp. human subj.: **a.** abs. after אָכַל, [Ho 4:10](https://ref.ly/Hos4:10), [Is 9:19](https://ref.ly/Isa9:19), [Dt 8:10](https://ref.ly/Deut8:10), [Ex 16:8](https://ref.ly/Exod16:8) (P), \+ II t., cf. [Ho 13:6](https://ref.ly/Hos13:6), [13:6](https://ref.ly/Hos13:6) (Isr. under fig. of cattle), [Je 50:19](https://ref.ly/Jer50:19) (id.; c. ב loc.; ‖רָעָה *graze*); \= have (or get) enough to eat [Psalm 37:19](https://ref.ly/Ps37:19), [59:16](https://ref.ly/Ps59:16), enough to drink [Am 4:8](https://ref.ly/Amos4:8), fig. of sword [Je 46:10](https://ref.ly/Jer46:10), of wine Hb [2:5](https://ref.ly/Hab2:5). **b.** c. acc. of food [Je 44:17](https://ref.ly/Jer44:17), [La 5:16](https://ref.ly/Lam5:16), [Ex 16:12](https://ref.ly/Exod16:12) (P), \+ 6 t., cf. ## I שָבַר (id: BDB09351)

\[Str7663] † I. \[שָבַר] **vb.** inspect, examine (van d.H. שֹׁבֵר \[so LXX συντρίβων], but Mas. ´ש: v. Norzi; hence connex. with Ar. سَبَرَ *probe* a wound, *try, examine,* improb., and this (acc. to Frä261) denom. from Aram. loan\-word; improb. also is connex. with Aram. סְבַר *think* (cf. foll.), KauAram. in AT, 85\);—**Qal** *Pt.* שבֵר, c. ב obj., [Ne 2:13](https://ref.ly/Neh2:13), [2:15](https://ref.ly/Neh2:15) I *examined into* the wall, inspected it closely.

* **Associated Passages:** Nehemiah 2:15; Nehemiah 2:13


## II שָבַר (id: BDB09352)

Aram. סְבַר think, Pa. *hope;* سَبَرَ *believe, hope,* Pa. *think,* Aph. *hope*);—*Pf.* 1 S שִבַּרְתִּי [Psalm 119:166](https://ref.ly/Ps119:166), 3 pl. שִבְּרוּ [Est 9:1](https://ref.ly/Esth9:1); *Impf.* 3 mpl. יְשַבְּרוּ [Is 38:18](https://ref.ly/Isa38:18), יְשַבֵָּרוּ [Psalm 145:15](https://ref.ly/Ps145:15), יְשַבֵּרָוּן [Psalm 104:27](https://ref.ly/Ps104:27); 2 fpl. תְּשַבֵּרְנָה [Ru 1:13](https://ref.ly/Ruth1:13);—**1\.** *wait* for, ל Pers., [Ru 1:13](https://ref.ly/Ruth1:13). **2\.** *hope* for, ל rei [Psalm 119:166](https://ref.ly/Ps119:166), אֶל rei [Is 38:18](https://ref.ly/Isa38:18), אֶל Pers. [Psalm 104:27](https://ref.ly/Ps104:27), [145:15](https://ref.ly/Ps145:15); ל inf. [Est 9:1](https://ref.ly/Esth9:1) *hope to rule*.

> \[Str7664] † \[שֵ֫בֶר] **n.m.** hope;—sf. שִבְרִי [Psalm 119:116](https://ref.ly/Ps119:116), ´שִבְרוֺ עַל־י: [146:5](https://ref.ly/Ps146:5).

## שָגַב (id: BDB09356)

\[Str7682] † \[שָגַב] **vb.** (inaccessibly) high (cf. Trgum שְגַב Pa. \[from Heb.] *exalt*);—*Qal* *Pf.* **1\.** 3 fs. שָֽגְבָה [Dt 2:36](https://ref.ly/Deut2:36), of city, c. מִן, *be* (too) *high* for capture. **2\.** 3 mpl. שָֽגְבוּ [Jb 5:11](https://ref.ly/Job5:11) of Pers., *be high* in prosperity. **Niph.** *Pf.* 3 ms. נִשְגַּב [Is 2:11](https://ref.ly/Isa2:11), [2:17](https://ref.ly/Isa2:17); נִשְגָּֽכ[Pr 18:10](https://ref.ly/Prov18:10); 3 fs. נִשְגְּבָה [Psalm 139:6](https://ref.ly/Ps139:6) *Pt.* נִשְגָּב [Is 12:4](https://ref.ly/Isa12:4) \+; fs. נִשְגָּבָה [Is 26:5](https://ref.ly/Isa26:5) \+;—**1\.** *be high,* walls [Is 30:13](https://ref.ly/Isa30:13), [Pr 18:11](https://ref.ly/Prov18:11); city [Is 26:5](https://ref.ly/Isa26:5); God’s knowledge [Psalm 139:6](https://ref.ly/Ps139:6) (unattainable). **2\.** *be* (safely) *set on high,* [Pr 18:10](https://ref.ly/Prov18:10). **3\.** *be exalted,* of God [Is 2:11](https://ref.ly/Isa2:11), [2:17](https://ref.ly/Isa2:17), [33:5](https://ref.ly/Isa33:5); his name [12:4](https://ref.ly/Isa12:4), [Psalm 148:13](https://ref.ly/Ps148:13). **Pi.** *Impf.* 3 ms. יְשַגֵּב [Is 9:10](https://ref.ly/Isa9:10), [Psalm 107:41](https://ref.ly/Ps107:41); sf. יְשַגֶּבְךָ [20:2](https://ref.ly/Ps20:2), etc.;—trans. c. acc.: **1\.** *set* (securely) *on high,* [Psalm 20:2](https://ref.ly/Ps20:2), [69:30](https://ref.ly/Ps69:30), [91:14](https://ref.ly/Ps91:14); c, מִן, of foe [59:2](https://ref.ly/Ps59:2), affliction [107:41](https://ref.ly/Ps107:41). **2\.** *exalt,* in effective hostility, c.עַל, [Is 9:10](https://ref.ly/Isa9:10). **Pu.** *Impf.* 3 ms. יְשָֻ\+גב [Pr 29:25](https://ref.ly/Prov29:25) *be set* (securely) *on high*. **Hiph.** *Impf.* 3 ms. יַשְגִּיב [Jb 36:22](https://ref.ly/Job36:22) God *acts exaltedly* בְּכֹחוֺ.

## שָׁבַת (id: BDB09681)

## I שָׁוָה (id: BDB09761)

\[Str7737] † I. שָׁוָה **vb.** (be even, smooth, v. **Pi.,** hence) agree with, be like, resemble (Ar. سوى II. *make even, flat, uniform* (with something else); Aram. שְׁוָא (der. spec.) *be like,* ܫܘܳܐ *be equal, fit, like,* Pa.*lay out smoothly,* Aph. *make plain, fit, worthy*);—**Qal** *Pf.* 3 ms. לִי ´לאֹ שׁ: [Jb 33:27](https://ref.ly/Job33:27) (si vera l.) *it was not equalled to me,* i.e. (v. infra; acc. to most) *not requited* (so De Di Da, and [Is 16:6](https://ref.ly/Isa16:6) Targum); Bu אֵל לאֹ שִׁוָּה *God did not requite* (or שִׁלֵּם for שׁוה); Du לאֹ שִׁוָּה כַעֲוֺנִי (cf. LXX); *Impf.* 1 s. of ´י:, אֶשְׁוֶה…אֶל־מִי: [Is 40:25](https://ref.ly/Isa40:25) *to whom shall I be like ?* (‖תְּדַמְּיוּנִי), implying that he is incomp.; 3 mpl. לאֹ יִשְׁווּ־בָהּ [Pr 3:15](https://ref.ly/Prov3:15) *are not comparable with her* (wisdom), so [8:11](https://ref.ly/Prov8:11); 2 ms. פֶּן־תִּשְׁוֶה־לוֺ [Pr 26:4](https://ref.ly/Prov26:4) *lest thou be like him* (a fool); *Pt.* שֹׁוֶה בְּ [Est 7:4](https://ref.ly/Esth7:4) *is* not *an equivalent for;* c. לִ, *suitable for* [3:8](https://ref.ly/Esth3:8), so [1:22](https://ref.ly/Esth1:22) Hi Or RyKau (rdg. כֹּל שֹׁוֶה עִמּוֺ for כִּלְשׁוֺן עַמּוֺ, but v. Siegf.); *adequate for* [5:13](https://ref.ly/Esth5:13). **Pi.** *Pf.* 3 ms. שִׁוָּה [Is 28:25](https://ref.ly/Isa28:25) *he hath levelled* its (the ground’s) surface; 1 s. שִׁוִּיתִי וְדוֺמַמְתִּי נַפְשִׁי [Psalm 131:2](https://ref.ly/Ps131:2) *I have smoothed* (composed) *and stilled my soul;* so, sc. נַפְשִׁי [Is 38:13](https://ref.ly/Isa38:13) Vulgate Ges De al.; Houb Lo Che Du al. read שִׁוַּעְתִּי *I cried;* acc. מִשְׁפָּטִים [119:30](https://ref.ly/Ps119:30) *accounted suitable,* *meet* (‖דֶּרֶךְ אֱמוּנָח בָּחָרְתִּי), Hi, cf. Gr v:[128](https://ref.ly/Ps119:128) (v. **Qal** [Est 3:8](https://ref.ly/Esth3:8)); We ins. לְנֶגְדִּי (II. ´שׁ:, cf. [Psalm 16:8](https://ref.ly/Ps16:8)); Zenner Du אִזִּיתִי. **Hiph.** *make like: Impf.* 1 S. מָךְ אַשְׁוֶח־לָךְ [La 2:13](https://ref.ly/Lam2:13) (‖אֲדַמֶּה); 2 mpl. לְמִי תְדַמְּיוּנִי וְתַשְׁווּ [Is 46:5](https://ref.ly/Isa46:5) (cf. **Qal** [40:25](https://ref.ly/Isa40:25)). **Nithp.** (appar.) *Pf.* 3 fs. נִשְׁתָּוָה (for נִשְׁתְּוָה) [Pr 27:15](https://ref.ly/Prov27:15) *are alike,* but read prob. ## I שָׁכַר (id: BDB09945)

\[Str7937] † I. \[שָׁכַר] **vb.** be, or beocme, drunk, drunken (NH *id.*, der. spec. and deriv.; [Ecclus 40:18](https://ref.ly/Sir40:18), [40:20](https://ref.ly/Sir40:20) שכר *strong drink;* Ar.سَكِرَ *be drunken*, also *be full*, سَكَرَ *fill;* As. *šikaru;* \= שֵׁכָר, *šikaru, drunken*, perhaps also vb. *šakâru;* Eth.ሰክረ፡: Aram. שִׁכְרָא, ܫܰܟܪܳܐ \= שְׁכָר, esp. *date\-wine* (Löw p. 125\), cf. ܫܟܰܪ *be drunken*, usu. (der. spec.) *defle, deform*, etc.; from שֵׁכָר, Egypt. *\&aubtà\-k\-av\-k\-ïra* WMM As. u. Eur. 102, Gk. σί̀κερα, Lewy Fremdw, 81\);—**Qal** *Pf.* 3 pl. שָֽׁכְרוּ [Is 29:9](https://ref.ly/Isa29:9); *Impf.* 3 ms. וַיִּשְׁכָּר[Gn 9:21](https://ref.ly/Gen9:21), 3 mpl. יִשְׁכָּרָוּן [Is 49:26](https://ref.ly/Isa49:26), etc.; *Imv*. mpl. שִׁכְרוּ [Je 25:27](https://ref.ly/Jer25:27) Ct [5:1](https://ref.ly/Song5:1); *Inf. cstr.* [Hg 1:6](https://ref.ly/Hag1:6); *Pt. pass.* שְׁכֻרַת[Is 51:21](https://ref.ly/Isa51:21) (Ges§ 130 b LagBN 60\);—*become drunken* [Gn 9:21](https://ref.ly/Gen9:21) (J), of social drinking [43:34](https://ref.ly/Gen43:34) (J), Ct [5:1](https://ref.ly/Song5:1), token of plenty [Hg 1:6](https://ref.ly/Hag1:6); fig. of nations staggering helplessly under calamity [Je 25:27](https://ref.ly/Jer25:27), [51:21](https://ref.ly/Jer51:21)(וְלאֹ מִָ\+יּיִן), of [Na 3:11](https://ref.ly/Nah3:11); of infatuation [Is 29:9](https://ref.ly/Isa29:9) (וְלאֹ יַיִן), of disgrace [La 4:21](https://ref.ly/Lam4:21), self\-destruction, ´כֶּעָסִיס דָּמָם יִשׁ: [Is 49:26](https://ref.ly/Isa49:26). **Pi.** *make drunken: Impf.* 3 ms. sf. וַיְשַׁכְּרֵהוּ [2 S 11:13](https://ref.ly/2Sam11:13), lit.; fig. 1 s. Sab. תַלל *plunder,* connecting this with Ar. ثَلَّةٌ *a flock of sheep* (or *goats*); then Targum שְׁלָלָא *booty,* and (rare) Syr. ܫܶܠܳܠ are loan\-words);—**Qal** *Pf.* 3 ms. consec. ´וְשׁ: Ez [26:12](https://ref.ly/Ezek26:12); 2 ms. שַׁלּוֺתָ Hb [2:8](https://ref.ly/Hab2:8), etc.; *Impf.* 3 mpl. sf. יְשָׁלּוּךָ v:[8](https://ref.ly/Hab2:8); cstr. לִשְׁלֽ [Is 10:6](https://ref.ly/Isa10:6) \+; *Pt.* pl. שֹׁלְלִים [Zc 2:12](https://ref.ly/Zech2:12), etc.;—*spoil, plunder* (usu. ‖בָּזַז), c. acc. cogn. שָׁלָל [Is 10:6](https://ref.ly/Isa10:6), Ez [29:19](https://ref.ly/Ezek29:19), [38:12](https://ref.ly/Ezek38:12), [38:13](https://ref.ly/Ezek38:13), [38:13](https://ref.ly/Ezek38:13), acc. חַיִל *wealth* [26:12](https://ref.ly/Ezek26:12); acc. Pers., שֹׁלְלִים [Je 50:10](https://ref.ly/Jer50:10), Hb [2:8](https://ref.ly/Hab2:8), Ez [39:10](https://ref.ly/Ezek39:10), גּוֺיִם רַבּים Hb [2:8](https://ref.ly/Hab2:8), cf. [Zc 2:12](https://ref.ly/Zech2:12). **Hithpō‘** *Pf.* 3 pl. אֶשְׁתּוֺלְלוּ אַבִּירֵי לֵב (א in ´אֶשְׁתּ: is Aram., or scribal error: Ges§ 54 a *n.,* cf. 58 k) [Psalm 76:6](https://ref.ly/Ps76:6) *the stout of heart are spoiled; Pt.* מִשְׁתּוֺלֵל [Is 59:15](https://ref.ly/Isa59:15) he that departs from evil *is one despoiled.*

## שָׁלַף (id: BDB10030)

[Jb 20:25](https://ref.ly/Job20:25); usu. sword from sheath Ju [8:20](https://ref.ly/Judg8:20), [9:54](https://ref.ly/Judg9:54), [1 S 31:4](https://ref.ly/1Sam31:4) \= [1 Ch 10:4](https://ref.ly/1Chr10:4), \+ מִתַּעְרָהּ [1 S 17:51](https://ref.ly/1Sam17:51); וְחַרְבּוֺ שָׁלוּפָה בְּיָדוֺ [Nu 22:23](https://ref.ly/Num22:23), [22:31](https://ref.ly/Num22:31), [Jos 5:13](https://ref.ly/Josh5:13) (all J), [1 Ch 21:16](https://ref.ly/1Chr21:16); elsewhere ´אִישׁ שֹׁלֵף ח: coll. ## שָׁמַט (id: BDB10070)

\[Str8058] † \[שָׁמַט] **vb.** let drop (NH *id., loosen, detach, draw away*, Niph. *slip off*; Aram. שְׁמַטּ *loosen, pull away*; ܫܡܰܛ *draw* sword, *draw* or *pull away*; Ar. سَمَطَ; is *hang, suspend, II. release* debtor (Kam), سِمْطٌ *string* of pearls);—**Qal** *let drop, fall: Imv*. mpl. sf. \+ *Impf*. 3 ms. sf. וַיִּשְׁמְטוּהָ (final ו dittogr.) שִׁמְטוּהָו [2 K 9:33](https://ref.ly/2Kgs9:33) he said, *Let her fall, and they let her fall*; then fig., of letting land rest in seventh year:, 2 ms. sf.: תִּשְׁמְטֶנָּה [Ex 23:11](https://ref.ly/Exod23:11) (E); *Pf.* 2 ms. וְשָׁמַטְתָּ֫ה\> [Je 17:4](https://ref.ly/Jer17:4) *thou shalt let drop* thy hand (read יָֽרְךָ for וּבְח JDMich and mod.) from (מִן) thine inheritance, i.e. abandon it; *Inf. abs*. שָׁמוֺט [Dt 15:2](https://ref.ly/Deut15:2) *let fall* (a debt in seventh year; v. מַשֶּׁה b).—Pf. 3 pl. שָֽׁמְטוּ הַבָּקָר [2 S 6:6](https://ref.ly/2Sam6:6)\= [1 Ch 13:9](https://ref.ly/1Chr13:9) is dub., most naturally either *they let the oxen fall* (slip, stumble), or (as Targan) *the oxen let it fall* (reading שְׁמָטוֺ, sc. the ark); \> Thes the *oxen ran away*; SyrVer *slipped* (the yoke)? v. further Dr. **Niph.** *Pf.* 3 pl. נִשְׁמְטוּ [Psalm 141:6](https://ref.ly/Ps141:6) their judges *have been thrown down*. **Hiph.** 2 ms. (?) juss. (?) תַּשְׁמֵט [Dt 15:3](https://ref.ly/Deut15:3) *thou, shalt cause* thy hand *to let drop*, etc.; BaNB 147 **Qal**; \< read תִּשְׁמֹט (cf. Dr), יָרֶָךָ: subj.

> \[Str8059] † שְׁמִטָּה **n.f.** a letting drop of exactions, a (temporary) remitting: ´תַּעֲשֶה שׁ: [Dt 15:1](https://ref.ly/Deut15:1)(at end of seven years), v:[2](https://ref.ly/Deut15:2) ´לי :´כִּי קָרָא שׁ:; whence seventh year is ´שְׁנַת הַשּׁ: v:[9](https://ref.ly/Deut15:9), [31:10](https://ref.ly/Deut31:10).

\[Str8173,8159] † I. \[שָׁעַע] **vb.** be smeared over, blinded (Aram. שְׁעַע *smear* (akin to שׁוּעַ id.), ܐܰܫܰܥ to *smooth,* שָׁעִיעַ *smooth* (of words), *flattering,* ܫܰܥܺܝܥ *smooth* (cf. also ܫܘܥ, ܫܳܥ *smear over, close up*);—**Qal** *Imv.* \+ **Hithpalp.** *Imv.* mpl. הִשְׁתַּעַשְׁעוּ וָשָֹׁעוּ [Is 29:9](https://ref.ly/Isa29:9) *blind yourselves and be blind !* (‖הִתְמַהְמְהוּ וּתְמָהוּ); \> Buhl הִשְׁתָּעוּ וּשְׁעוּ, √שׁעה *look about* ([2 S 22:42](https://ref.ly/2Sam22:42)); [Is 32:3](https://ref.ly/Isa32:3) rd. prob. 3 fpl. תְּשֹׁעֶינָה, of eyes, *be blinded* (v. שׁעה). **Hiph.** *Imv.* ms. וְעֵינָיו הָשַָׁע [Is 6:10](https://ref.ly/Isa6:10) *and its eyes besmear !*—So perhaps הָשַׁע [Psalm 39:14](https://ref.ly/Ps39:14) (עֵינֶיךָ om.) was intended by Mas. (but wrongly, v. Ol al.); see שָׁעָה. p. 1043

* **Associated Passages:** Isaiah 29:9; Psalms 39:14; Isaiah 32:3; 2 Samuel 22:42; Isaiah 6:10
